claims.source_text: Oracle's fourth quarter fiscal 2026 earnings call
claims.claim: Oracle held its fourth quarter fiscal 2026 earnings call.
claims.explanation_ko: 제시된 증거에는 2026 회계연도 4분기 실적 발표가 있었다는 내용은 포함되어 있지 않습니다.

claims.source_text: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure revenue grew 52 percent year over year this quarter.
claims.claim: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure revenue increased by 52 percent year-over-year in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026.
claims.explanation_ko: 증거에 따르면 오라클 클라우드 인프라 매출은 전년 대비 42% 증가했으며, 52% 증가했다는 주장은 사실과 다릅니다.

evidence.title: Oracle cloud infrastructure revenue rises 42%
evidence.snippet: Oracle reported Oracle Cloud Infrastructure revenue of $3.9 billion for the quarter, up 42 percent year over year. Total cloud revenue rose 27 percent.

evidence.title: Oracle OCI growth cools to 42% as capex climbs
evidence.snippet: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure revenue grew 42 percent in the quarter. The company guided capital expenditures above $25 billion, pressuring gross margin.

claims.source_text: Capital expenditures will exceed 25 billion dollars this fiscal year.
claims.claim: Oracle management issued a forecast that capital expenditures will exceed 25 billion dollars for the 2026 fiscal year.
claims.explanation_ko: 제공된 증거에 따르면 오라클 경영진은 자본 지출이 250억 달러를 초과할 것으로 전망했습니다.
